kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
ننتصر (form VIII)
# نَنْتَصِرُ (nantaṣiru) /nan.ta.sˤi.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْتَصَرَ (intaṣara)
# نَنْتَصِرَ (nantaṣira) /nan.ta.sˤi.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْتَصَرَ (intaṣara)
# نَنْتَصِرْ (nantaṣir) /nan.ta.sˤir/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْتَصَرَ (intaṣara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
